payload.reason: The hydraulic conductivity (kh) values used in the study are derived from a fixed value of saturated hydraulic conductivity (K_H) set at 10^-5 m s^-1 for all stratigraphies, as stated in the evidence.

claims.text: The hydraulic conductivity (K_H) values used in the study are fixed at 10^-5 m s^-1 for all stratigraphies.
The study acknowledges that true hydraulic conductivities may differ between stratigraphies but uses a constant value for simplicity.
